Los instrumentos y componentes avanzados: Advanced instruments and components take longer to build and test.
Los lugares más interesantes casi nunca: The most interesting places are almost never right where it's safe to land. A rover can travel to them.
Los motores frenaron el descenso a tiemp: The engines slowed the descent in time: you're on the Moon!
Los paneles solares generan energía solo: Solar panels only make power with light and produce less far from the Sun. An RTG (radioisotope nuclear generator, like Curiosity's) delivers steady power day and night, but it's expensive and scarce.
Mapea inundaciones y terremotos aunque h: Maps floods and earthquakes even through clouds or at night, in under 24 hours.
Marte recibe menos de la mitad de la luz: Mars gets less than half the sunlight Earth does and its nights last ~12 hours and are freezing. Data travels to Earth through relay orbiters that pass by only a few times a day. Heat shield, parachute and retrorockets almost double the mass to launch.
Más años = más ciencia, pero más costo d: More years = more science, but higher operating costs and more time exposed to failures and radiation.
Masa de equipos e instrumentos frente a: Mass of equipment and instruments compared to what the structure can hold.
Masa total con 10% de margen de diseño f: Total mass with a 10% design margin compared to what the rocket can carry to the chosen orbit.
Memoria corrupta en la COMPUTADORA A: un: Corrupted memory in COMPUTER A: a high-energy particle from space changed its data. Computer B (backup) is healthy.
Mide el calor: detecta incendios activos: Measures heat: detects active fires, volcanoes and the temperature of oceans and cities.
Mide el campo magnético que trae el vien: Measures the magnetic field carried by the solar wind. Light, cheap and uses almost no power.
Mide humedad del suelo, lluvia y tempera: Measures soil moisture, rain and air temperature, even through clouds. Key for climate and weather forecasting.
Mide temperatura, humedad, aerosoles y o: Measures temperature, humidity, aerosols and oceans across the whole planet for at least 5 years.
Mientras más alta la órbita, menos masa: The higher the orbit, the less mass a rocket can carry.

Ojos del rover: fotografía el paisaje en: The rover's eyes: photographs the landscape in color and 3D to choose where to go and what to study.
Orbi, tu copiloto, te dirá qué hacer en: Orbi, your copilot, will tell you what to do at every moment. Complete the steps in the Flight plan until they're all ✅ and then press "Simulate mission".
Órbita polar que cruza cada lugar a la m: Polar orbit that passes over each place at the same local time. Ideal for observing Earth and comparing images over time. It costs a bit more to reach than a normal LEO.
Para aprender jugando. Sin daños, sin re: To learn while playing. No damage, no delays: just power, instruments and communications.
Para aterrizar en la Luna hay que frenar: To land on the Moon you have to brake with engines: the landing fuel doubles the mass to launch. At the south pole the Sun stays very low and there are craters in eternal shadow that may hold water ice.
Para ganar más estrellas: ahorra dinero: To earn more stars: save money (for example with a cheaper rocket), add ★★★ instruments or make the mission last more years.
Para llegar a órbitas muy lejanas (geoes: To reach very distant orbits (geostationary or L1) the rocket isn't enough: your satellite needs its own engine. In 🛰️ Spacecraft choose Hydrazine.
Partículas energéticas dañan la computad: Energetic particles damage the computer. The spacecraft runs at reduced capacity.
Pasaste mucho tiempo en arena blanda (la: You spent a lot of time in soft sand (the light patches on the ground). Going around it saves power and time.
Perfora rocas y guarda muestras. Consume: Drills into rocks and stores samples. Uses a lot of power while drilling.
Permite corregir la órbita, compensar el: Lets you correct the orbit, offset atmospheric drag (longer lifetime) and reach distant orbits like GEO or L1.
Plantar la antena repetidora con el braz: Plant the relay antenna with the robotic arm (G key)
Ponle motor si vas lejos: Add an engine if you're going far
Prueba diseños extremos y observa qué re: Try extreme designs and see which resource breaks first.
Press DIAGNOSIS to find out what failed.
Pulsa REINICIAR para arrancar con la com: Press REBOOT to start up with computer B.
Punto de equilibrio entre la Tierra y el: Balance point between Earth and the Sun. No eclipses and a constant view of the Sun: perfect for watching solar storms ~1 hour before they arrive. It's very far away: it needs the Deep Space Network (more expensive) and a powerful antenna.
Que dure al menos {n} años: Make it last at least {n} years
{mb} MB were left unsent to Earth. With a faster radio (X or Ka band) each orbiter pass carries more data.

Se acerca un huracán y las cámaras no ve: A hurricane is coming and cameras can't see through the clouds. Rescue teams need images day and night: can you design a satellite that sees with radar?
Se pierde el {pct}% de los datos por fal: {pct}% of the data is lost due to a lack of link time.
Selecciona los instrumentos que cumplen: Picks the instruments that meet the science goal.
Si la nave no apunta con precisión, las: If the spacecraft doesn't point precisely, images come out blurry or aimed at the wrong place.
Si se gasta más energía de la que produc: If you use more energy than the panels produce, the battery drains and the spacecraft goes into safe mode.
Sigue a Orbi y tu Plan de vuelo: Follow Orbi and your Flight plan
Sin instrumentos no hay ciencia que repo: Without instruments there's no science to report.
without going over on money, weight or power.
Sin propulsión la nave reentra y se desi: Without propulsion the spacecraft re-enters and burns up: it leaves no space junk.
Sin propulsión propia la nave queda atra: Without its own propulsion the spacecraft gets stuck in the transfer orbit.
Sin restricciones de presupuesto ni plaz: No budget or deadline limits. Experiment with any combination.
Sin rover tu aterrizador solo puede estu: Without a rover your lander can only study the spot where it lands (and you won't be able to explore).
Solo caben {n} instrumentos en esta estr: Only {n} instruments fit in this structure.
Solo llega a Tierra el {pct}% de los dat: Only {pct}% of the data reaches Earth.
Solo para misiones a la superficie de la: Only for missions to the surface of the Moon or Mars. A rover can travel to different interesting places; a fixed lander only studies the spot where it lands.
Solo puedes bajar el {pct}% de los datos: You can only downlink {pct}% of the data produced ({gen} GB/day vs {down} GB/day).
supera tu mejor marca para sumar más: beat your best score to earn more
Tapa el disco del Sol para ver su corona: Blocks the Sun's disk to see its corona and detect coronal mass ejections heading toward Earth.
Te quedaron datos sin enviar: plantar un: You had data left unsent: planting a relay antenna on high ground (G key) lets you transmit without waiting for the orbiter.
Termina una exploración en nivel Comanda: Finish an exploration at Commander level with at least 1 star.
Tiempo para construir y probar la nave f: Time to build and test the spacecraft compared to the mission deadline.
Toca la rueda que aparece en ROJO para p: Tap the wheel shown in RED to put it in FREE mode.
Tras muchos ciclos profundos la batería: After many deep cycles the battery stopped charging. The spacecraft shut down.
Tu batería se agotó {n} vez/veces. Prueb: Your battery ran out {n} time(s). Try a bigger battery, bigger panels or a nuclear RTG that works at night.
Tu batería se agotó {n} vez/veces. Una b: Your battery ran out {n} time(s). A bigger battery would give you more range.
Tu misión cuesta {cost} millones y tiene: Your mission costs {cost} million and you have {budget}. Try a cheaper rocket (rideshare is the cheapest) or remove expensive instruments.
Tu misión necesita funcionar varios años: Your mission needs to run for several years. In 🧭 Mission move the lifetime slider. If the orbit is very low, the satellite falls early: give it a small engine (cold gas).
Tu nave viaja junto a muchas otras en un: Your spacecraft travels with many others on the same rocket. Very cheap (you pay per kg), but you don't choose the date or exact orbit and there are mass limits.
Tu nueva agencia espacial recibe su prim: Your new space agency gets its first job: watching forest fires in Latin America. Show that you can put a satellite in orbit without going over budget.
Your progress is saved in this browser. You can start the campaign from scratch (for example, for another player).
Tu rover es lento. Un rover más grande a: Your rover is slow. A bigger rover moves faster, though it weighs and costs more.
Tu rover quedó atrapado en la sombra ete: Your rover got stuck in the eternal shadow. To go into those craters you need a big battery (or an RTG) and to get out quickly.
Tu satélite pesa demasiado para ese cohe: Your satellite is too heavy for that rocket, or the rocket can't go that far. In 🧭 Mission pick one that says "kg to this orbit" with a number bigger than your spacecraft's weight.
Tus equipos gastan {use} W y tus paneles: Your equipment uses {use} W and your solar panels give {gen} W. In 🛰️ Spacecraft pick bigger panels or remove power-hungry instruments.
Tus instrumentos toman más fotos y datos: Your instruments collect more photos and data than your radio can send. In 📡 Communications pick a faster radio (X or Ka band).
Tus paneles terminaron con {pct}% de pol: Your panels ended up {pct}% covered in dust. On Mars an RTG doesn't have this problem.
Un instrumento consume más potencia pico: An instrument needs more peak power than the system can deliver.
Un resto del delta que la erosión dejó a: A piece of the delta left isolated by erosion. Its walls are too steep to climb, but photos show its layers like a history book.
Un rover solo sirve si la misión aterriz: A rover is only useful if the mission lands on the Moon or Mars.
Una estación de Tierra estuvo fuera de s: A ground station was out of service for maintenance.
Una falla crítica de electrónica terminó: A critical electronics failure ended the mission early.
Una rueda consume demasiada corriente (m: One wheel draws too much current (see it in RED on the wheel map). Put it in FREE mode so it rolls without its motor, then test the motors.
Una tormenta solar o una falla dañó tu s: A solar storm or a failure damaged your satellite. A "radiation-hardened" computer (advanced components) protects it better.
Una tormenta solar podría apagar satélit: A solar storm could knock out satellites and power grids on Earth. Take an observatory 1.5 million kilometers away to raise the alarm in time.
Uno de los lanzadores más confiables de: One of the most reliable rockets in history. Expensive, but ideal for high-value science missions.
Vas a aterrizar en otro mundo. En 🛰️ Nav: You're going to land on another world. In 🛰️ Spacecraft, Mobility section, pick a rover: then you can drive it and visit the most interesting places.
Vas a diseñar un satélite de verdad. Tu: You're going to design a real satellite. Your job: make it complete its mission (for example, finding fires) without spending more money than you have.
Ve a 🔬 Ciencia y escoge instrumentos con: Go to 🔬 Science and pick instruments with ★★★ stars: those are the ones that help your goal. The ones that say "doesn't help" only waste money and power.
Ve en varios 'colores' invisibles al ojo: Sees in several 'colors' invisible to the eye (near infrared): reveals plant health, burned areas and land use.
Ve las capas bajo el suelo hasta 10 m de: Sees layers underground down to 10 m deep: buried ice, ancient rivers and sediments.

Vista permanente del Sol (y del lado diu: Permanent view of the Sun (and Earth's daytime side)
